Update Chasen Anim for Zig **0.17.0**.

## Changed

- Require Zig 0.17.0 and use it for Linux and macOS CI.
- Update installation and development documentation for the supported toolchain.

Animation APIs and implementation are unchanged. The package continues to use
only the Zig standard library.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen-anim/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
